The execution failed due to incorrect financial calculations in the reagent kit bulk analysis, resulting in significant discrepancies in assay margins and totals.
The test_rows_and_order failed with a value mismatch in assay margins: close(441.6, 5740.8) returned False. Additionally, test_totals_and_decision failed when total_annual_margin_small_kit_usd was calculated as 21496.81 instead of the expected -7106.39. Subprocess execution of /tests/test_outputs.py via pytest returned a non-zero exit code, triggering an AssertionError in the test_legacy_pytest_suite wrapper.
